tools.name: key_type
tools.description: Input a continuous string of text at the current cursor position.

text.description: The plain text content to type

tools.name: key_press
tools.description: Press and hold a single keyboard key without releasing it.

key.description: Single key name: shift, ctrl, alt, win, enter, space, backspace, tab, up, down, left, right, escape, f1-f12 etc.

tools.name: key_release
tools.description: Release a previously held keyboard key.

tools.name: key_tap
tools.description: Tap a single key once (press and release immediately).

key.description: Single key to tap, e.g. enter, space, delete, esc

tools.name: key_hotkey
tools.description: Execute shortcut combination keys, pass multiple keys separated by comma.

keys.description: Combination keys, example: ctrl,c / ctrl,shift,s / win,d

tools.name: key_backspace
tools.description: Tap backspace key to delete one character forward.

tools.name: key_delete
tools.description: Tap delete key to erase character after cursor.

tools.name: key_enter
tools.description: Press enter key to confirm or new line.

tools.name: key_tab
tools.description: Tap tab key to switch focus to next input box.

tools.name: key_space
tools.description: Tap space key to input blank space.

tools.name: key_escape
tools.description: Tap ESC key to close popups/cancel operations.

tools.name: key_arrow_up
tools.description: Tap up arrow key to move cursor up.

tools.name: key_arrow_down
tools.description: Tap down arrow key to move cursor down.

tools.name: key_arrow_left
tools.description: Tap left arrow key to move cursor left.

tools.name: key_arrow_right
tools.description: Tap right arrow key to move cursor right.

tools.name: key_page_up
tools.description: Tap PageUp to scroll view upward.

tools.name: key_page_down
tools.description: Tap PageDown to scroll view downward.

tools.name: key_home
tools.description: Jump cursor to the start of current line.

tools.name: key_end
tools.description: Jump cursor to the end of current line.

tools.name: key_wait_input
tools.description: Pause for specified milliseconds before next keyboard operation.
